units.source_text: 為此，他在老家蓋了一棟養老隱居的新房，對東京似乎已不再留戀。

en.t: For that reason, he built a new house in his hometown for his retirement and seclusion, and seemed to have no lingering attachment to Tokyo anymore.

units.source_text: 他或許覺得我充其量不過是一個高中生，為我保留別墅和傭人是一種浪費吧

en.t: He probably thought it would be a waste to keep a villa and servants for me, since I was, at most, only a high school student.

units.source_text: （父親的心思與世人一樣，不是我都能理解的）。

en.t: Like the thoughts of people in general, my father's mind was not something I could fully understand.

units.source_text: 總之，這棟別墅不久就轉售給了別人，

en.t: In any case, before long that villa was resold to someone else,

units.source_text: 而我也搬進了本鄉森川町一個叫「仙遊館」的陰暗公寓裡，生活頓時變得拮据窘迫。

en.t: and I moved into a gloomy boarding house in Hongo Morikawa-cho called Senyukan, where my life at once became cramped and impoverished.
